name: Storybook Windmill — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Cream cylindrical windmill tower with cedar lattice sails in a four-arm arrangement, small blue/slate roof, gold crest, round planted gallery and ivy/rose-covered lower arches. Source shows no complete milling interior or working pivot detail. Hidden layout inference: Let a small meadow path meet the round garden apron and lower doorway, then loop around the tower to a village/forest return. One modest balcony overlooks the clearing; keep planted beds clear of entry and any moving-sail envelope. Use it as an exploration landmark, not a new kitchen or industrial service room. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B13-STRUCT-001 — Storybook Windmill — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need tapered wall/window host, gallery ring, roof/pivot bearing, lattice sail/hub interfaces and garden stair landing. Existing cedar/cream/gold/ivy vocabulary reused; rotation mechanics require later geometry/animation. Meadow flora/hazel; swallows/bees/ladybirds proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B13-STRUCT-001-S01 — Tapered mill shaft. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated tapered mill shaft matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
